IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB' and table_schema = 'EDS' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB;
END;
IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB' and table_schema = 'EDS' and table_type = 'VIEW')
BEGIN
   DROP VIEW EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB;
END;


CREATE TABLE EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=HASH(CIF_NO)
)
AS
SELECT CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID
	, VERSION
	, CUST_ID
	, ACCT_NO
	, CIF_NO
	, ACCT_TYPE_ID
	, CURRENCY_ID
	, ACCT_STATUS_ID
	, ACCT_STATUS_DT
	, ACCT_NM
	, ACCT_ALIAS
	, STATUS
	, STATUS_CHANGE_DT
	, ATM_CARD_NO
	, REMARKS
	, ACCT_PROD_ID
	, RELATION_ID
	, UNENROLLMENT_REF_NO
	, TXN_CHANNEL
	, LAST6_ACCT_NUM
	, BRANCH_ID
	, LOC_REF_NO
	, IS_PRIMARY_ACCT
	, ACCT_TYPE_IND
	, SECONDARY_FIELD1
	, SECONDARY_FIELD2
	, SECONDARY_FIELD3
	, SECONDARY_FIELD4
	, CREATED_BY
	, UPDATED_BY
	, CREATED_DATE
	, UPDATED_DATE
	, FLAGS
	, DISPLAY_CHANNEL
	, ALLOW_VIEW
	, ALLOW_DEBIT
	, ALLOW_CREDIT
	, ALLOW_PEEKBALANCE
	, Cast(START_DATE AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, insert_dttm
FROM 
(
	SELECT CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID
		, VERSION
		, CUST_ID
		, ACCT_NO
		, CIF_NO
		, ACCT_TYPE_ID
		, CURRENCY_ID
		, ACCT_STATUS_ID
		, ACCT_STATUS_DT
		, ACCT_NM
		, ACCT_ALIAS
		, STATUS
		, STATUS_CHANGE_DT
		, ATM_CARD_NO
		, REMARKS
		, ACCT_PROD_ID
		, RELATION_ID
		, UNENROLLMENT_REF_NO
		, TXN_CHANNEL
		, LAST6_ACCT_NUM
		, BRANCH_ID
		, LOC_REF_NO
		, IS_PRIMARY_ACCT
		, ACCT_TYPE_IND
		, SECONDARY_FIELD1
		, SECONDARY_FIELD2
		, SECONDARY_FIELD3
		, SECONDARY_FIELD4
		, CREATED_BY
		, UPDATED_BY
		, CREATED_DATE
		, UPDATED_DATE
		, FLAGS
		, DISPLAY_CHANNEL
		, ALLOW_VIEW
		, ALLOW_DEBIT
		, ALLOW_CREDIT
		, ALLOW_PEEKBALANCE
		, isActive
		, isLatest
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, insert_dttm
		, Row_Number() Over (PARTITION BY CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID, CIF_NO ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) SEQ_NUMBER
		, Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID, CIF_NO ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID
			, VERSION
			, CUST_ID
			, ACCT_NO
			, CIF_NO
			, ACCT_TYPE_ID
			, CURRENCY_ID
			, ACCT_STATUS_ID
			, ACCT_STATUS_DT
			, ACCT_NM
			, ACCT_ALIAS
			, STATUS
			, STATUS_CHANGE_DT
			, ATM_CARD_NO
			, REMARKS
			, ACCT_PROD_ID
			, RELATION_ID
			, UNENROLLMENT_REF_NO
			, TXN_CHANNEL
			, LAST6_ACCT_NUM
			, BRANCH_ID
			, LOC_REF_NO
			, IS_PRIMARY_ACCT
			, ACCT_TYPE_IND
			, SECONDARY_FIELD1
			, SECONDARY_FIELD2
			, SECONDARY_FIELD3
			, SECONDARY_FIELD4
			, CREATED_BY
			, UPDATED_BY
			, CREATED_DATE
			, UPDATED_DATE
			, FLAGS
			, DISPLAY_CHANNEL
			, ALLOW_VIEW
			, ALLOW_DEBIT
			, ALLOW_CREDIT
			, ALLOW_PEEKBALANCE
			, ISACTIVE
			, ISLATEST
			, BNK_CODE
			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, insert_dttm
			, ROW_NUMBER() 
				OVER(PARTITION BY CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID
						, VERSION
						, CUST_ID
						, ACCT_NO
						, CIF_NO
						, ACCT_TYPE_ID
						, CURRENCY_ID
						, ACCT_STATUS_ID
						, ACCT_STATUS_DT
						, ACCT_NM
						, ACCT_ALIAS
						, STATUS
						, STATUS_CHANGE_DT
						, ATM_CARD_NO
						, REMARKS
						, ACCT_PROD_ID
						, RELATION_ID
						, UNENROLLMENT_REF_NO
						, TXN_CHANNEL
						, LAST6_ACCT_NUM
						, BRANCH_ID
						, LOC_REF_NO
						, IS_PRIMARY_ACCT
						, ACCT_TYPE_IND
						, SECONDARY_FIELD1
						, SECONDARY_FIELD2
						, SECONDARY_FIELD3
						, SECONDARY_FIELD4
						, CREATED_BY
						, UPDATED_BY
						, CREATED_DATE
						, UPDATED_DATE
						, FLAGS
						, DISPLAY_CHANNEL
						, ALLOW_VIEW
						, ALLOW_DEBIT
						, ALLOW_CREDIT
						, ALLOW_PEEKBALANCE
		--				, ISACTIVE
		--				, ISLATEST
						, BNK_CODE
						, SOURCE_CODE
						, FILE_NAME
		--				, insert_dttm
			ORDER BY insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO
		FROM  BUSC.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB
	) AS TMP
	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK;
